title: ecb is focusing wrong risk 100 oil 2026 09 10
author: Jon Sindreu
text:
LONDON, Sept 10 (Reuters Breakingviews) - The central bank raised rates to 2.5% and didn't dispel expectations of ​three more hikes by April. ​Resilient euro zone growth has emboldened ⁠it to keep tightening. Yet ​with workers and firms swallowing the ​pain of high energy costs, a slowdown is a bigger risk than inflation.
